metadata.title: Land cover and wetlands
metadata.source: USGS Annual NLCD Collection 1.2 · MRLC raw WCS
metadata.displaySupport: Coarse categorical service overview; approximately 4–7 km spacing; local composition unknown
metadata.method: Request 2025 raw class-valued GeoTIFF from the official USGS MRLC WCS at 1180 × 520 pixels with nearest-neighbor interpolation. Use the returned affine coordinates, not the requested bounding box, because server reprojection expands the extent. Read integer band values directly, retain provider palette labels, and convert NoData 250 to null. Preserve the valid USGS CONUS footprint including inland and coastal water; use 2025 Census outlines as reference only. No color decoding, class averaging, gap filling, area-majority inference, or mobility scoring.
limitations: Calendar-year 2025 land cover is separate from the November 2006–2025 climate baseline; it is not a November vegetation or harvest observation.
The underlying NLCD source has 30 m cells. This downloadable display layer is a much coarser categorical service overview, with approximately 4–7 km spacing across CONUS.

Nearest-neighbor interpolation was requested. The provider may use internal raster overviews whose generation method was not independently verified; output classes are neither validated native-pixel point samples nor area-majority classes.

A class shown at an overview cell does not establish the class at every location within that cell. Narrow wetlands, wooded strips, small water bodies, and mixed landscapes can be omitted or generalized.
Land-cover classes do not measure tree spacing, understory density, vegetation height at a specific date, soil strength, surface-water depth, or current wetness.
Wetland classes indicate vegetation associated with periodic saturation or inundation, not observed water level. Open water carries no depth, crossing, bridge, or drinking-water-quality conclusion.
Developed classes are retained as source land-cover categories; individual road and building layers are excluded.

The valid USGS CONUS source footprint is preserved, including mapped inland and coastal water beyond generalized Census land outlines. Neither outline is an exact administrative or shoreline boundary. Null cells remain source NoData; they are not favorable conditions.
Sample counts are overview grid counts, not estimates of national land-cover area. The geographic grid is not equal-area.
metadata.overviewCountMeaning: Counts of coarse geographic-grid cells, not land-area percentages.

classes.label: Open water
classes.description: Open-water land cover; no depth, current, seasonal stage, or drinking-water quality is inferred.

classes.label: Perennial ice/snow
classes.description: Persistent ice/snow land cover; this is not November snowfall or seasonal snow depth.

classes.label: Developed, open space
classes.description: Mostly vegetation within developed settings; no individual building or road geometry.

classes.label: Developed, low intensity
classes.description: A mixture of development and vegetation; no individual building or road geometry.

classes.label: Developed, medium intensity
classes.description: A greater proportion of developed surface; no individual building or road geometry.

classes.label: Developed, high intensity
classes.description: Predominantly developed surface; no individual building or road geometry.

classes.label: Barren land (rock/sand/clay)
classes.description: Sparse vegetation over exposed rock or other earth materials; no soil-bearing strength is inferred.

classes.label: Deciduous forest
classes.description: Forest dominated by seasonally leaf-shedding trees; trunk spacing and understory are not measured here.

classes.label: Evergreen forest
classes.description: Forest dominated by evergreen trees; trunk spacing and understory are not measured here.

classes.label: Mixed forest
classes.description: Forest containing both deciduous and evergreen trees; trunk spacing and understory are not measured here.

classes.label: Shrub/scrub
classes.description: Shrub vegetation, including some young or stunted trees; local stem density is unknown.

classes.label: Grassland/herbaceous
classes.description: Predominantly grasses and other non-woody vegetation; November height and ground condition are unknown.

classes.label: Pasture/hay
classes.description: Managed forage vegetation; harvest, mowing, grazing, and November surface condition are unknown.

classes.label: Cultivated crops
classes.description: Cultivated land, including some orchards and vineyards; November harvest and tillage status are unknown.

classes.label: Woody wetlands
classes.description: Woody vegetation associated with periodic saturation or inundation; current wetness and depth are unknown.

classes.label: Emergent herbaceous wetlands
classes.description: Non-woody wetland vegetation associated with periodic saturation or inundation; current wetness and depth are unknown.

grid.support: Provider overview classes; not per-cell majority or exact native-pixel samples
grid.scope: Valid USGS CONUS source footprint; source NoData preserved
